verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer bulk filing or bulk lookups, such as batch annual reports for agents managing many entities, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only single-entity workflows: the Annual Report Wizard, entity search by Filing ID or name, and individual amendments. The Commercial Registered Agent registration for agents with more than 10 companies is a registration category, not a bulk-operation capability, and probes found no public API that could enable batch actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
